reuse.why: Routes the four inline midpoint copies (forecast, action sync, posting, preview) through the existing getScheduledAmount, which client components already use.

duplication.why: Removes four duplicated amount dispatches; only schedule-template keeps its own isbetween ternary, now calling the shared range function.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, the home of schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, a comment and tests change.

maintainability.why: One function defines the worst case; the template path still chooses between range and single amount itself rather than calling getScheduledAmount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts calls getWorstCaseAmount directly inside its own op check rather than getScheduledAmount, but the rule itself is shared

one_place.where: getWorstCaseAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount (posting, preview, forecast, action sync, client views) and by schedule-template.ts
